headline: Binance Reverses To A 321.7 Million Dollar Intake From A 72.3 Million Dollar Outflow
narrative: Binance took in 321.7 million dollars after a 72.3 million dollar outflow, which means dollars arrived at the largest venue where holders can sell after they had been leaving. Bybit took in 168.3 million dollars, up from 151.0 million dollars, while Bitfinex intake fell to 4.9 million dollars from 84.6 million dollars, which means the new dollars stayed at Binance and Bybit rather than arriving at Bitfinex. The 24-hour change in dollars held on trading venues, excluding each venue's own token, was a 366.5 million dollar net inflow, 0.134 percent of custodied value, compared with a 3.0 million dollar net outflow on the prior print, which means dollars are arriving at the venues as a group after they had been leaving.
author: jordan
